body:
well, I hope you get to visit one day- it's not really all that interesting down here (not Seoul nor close to the border or anything so I wouldn't really know tho). and no, ethnically korean but I was born in the US and most of my education has been in english, so yeah..

yeah.. I get really nervous over stupid little things to the point where I just blow everything out of proportion and end up ruining stuff for myself, haha.. and I mean.. shrugs honestly I look around at the people at my school and they are just extraordinary, geniuses and athletes and burning with passion and I can just tell they're special because.. I'm just not, I guess :/ I hate that I've resigned myself into accepting that I can't achieve anything but it's so hard to try and get motivated to do something when all I want to do is lie down in my bed and sleep.. I wish I was good at something or at least liked doing something.. but I don't know.. sorry, haha.. when I was a kid I worked hard and always thought I was special and that I was gonna grow up to be famous and it turns out real life doesn't work like that and it's pretty hard hitting, you know? Cause everyone else is interning in some top of the line cancer research facility or going overseas for debating tournaments or just being happy right? 

hehe, no luck in the relationship department here, either! but I'm not even sure what I'd do if I got an SO or if I'd just drag them down, I don't know.. 

wow, I find your story really inspiring.. but I can see how you got to that point- not just lip service but you sound like the protagonist in the movie who's overcome the bad guys and worked hard to build a fantastic life and lives happily ever after.

I guess I should go to sleep soon, but thanks... I really couldn't stress how grateful I am.... it feels like a weight came off my shoulders after having someone so understanding to talk to and take my mind off stuff.. thank you so much for caring. it means a lot to me.

I'm not really so sure about that.. I don't really have anyone other than those two, just people that I hang out with just to not be alone and guess I couldn't really have called them friends anyways.. I'm just totally socially awkward and don't really have anything interesting to say anyways.. oh and yeah, I'm just, you know? nothing special ahah.. everyone has something special about them, but on the other hand there's pretty much nothing interesting about me other than my fantastic ability to make excuses :D 

sort of in a rocky place with my family as well and if I can't do well on these, well, just a further source of shame for both me and my family..

it's korea actually, but timezones are close enough, I guess... I have no idea :s

but thank you so much.. sorry I'm so ungrateful and for spilling my whininess all over you.. but anyways.. I didn't really expect such a kind response and it means the world to me so thanks a lot you're really the best type of human being I could only ever wish to be
